input.quote: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
input.rationale: § 3.2 auto-renews each Service Option Attachment for a term equal in duration to the prior term, which permits automatic multi-year renewals (walk-away), and requires 90 days' non-renewal notice, exceeding both our preferred 30-day and fallback 60-day windows. There is no renewal reminder and no cap on renewal Charges (§ 4.1 leaves Charges to the Service Option Attachments and Order Forms with no uplift limit). Redline fixes renewals at 12 months, shortens notice to 30 days, adds a 60-day IBM reminder, and caps uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3%.

ops.oldText: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
ops.newText: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for successive terms of twelve (12) months unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment. IBM will notify Customer in writing at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term of the upcoming renewal and of any Charges proposed for the renewal term. Charges for any renewal term will not exceed the Charges in effect during the immediately preceding term by more than the lesser of (a) the percentage increase in the U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI-U, All Items) over the preceding twelve (12) months and (b) three percent (3%).

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have set renewals at 12 months with a 30-day non-renewal notice, an IBM renewal reminder 60 days out, and renewal Charges capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%, consistent with our position that renewals be easy to exit and predictably priced. If helpful, we can accept a 60-day notice window and a 5% cap as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice to 30 days, fix renewal term at 12 months, add 60-day renewal reminder and CPI/3% cap on renewal Charges.
